# Wait for color state, preserve the chosen identity and remove the observer

Compose waits for FolderTreeProperties.ready before FillIdentityList. On server-color-changed, the observer remembers the selected identitykey, rebuilds items, restores that identity and runs LoadIdentity(true). The unload path removes the same observer. Keep data readiness, selected identity and observer lifetime together when changing this picker. New/deleted-account refresh was outside the original patch. Current tests contain a debug-only delay for a later intermittent; that workaround is not a preferred general waiting rule. Source and tests were inspected without opening a compose window.

Scope: Compose identity color lifecycle.
